title: Repentance
definition: Repentance is a Spirit-worked turning from sin toward God, involving sorrow for sin, confession, changed direction, and renewed obedience.
summary: Repentance is not self-punishment or mere regret. It is a grace of God that brings a person honestly before Him and turns the heart toward Christ.
christFocus: True repentance leads to Christ, not despair. At the cross, sinners find both the seriousness of sin and the mercy of God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Repentance includes a changed mind, heart, and direction.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Repentance is joined with faith in the Gospel.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: The Spirit uses repentance to bring sinners out of hiding and into the mercy of Christ.
